evidence.detail: The enum constants survive exactly as FIXED, RESIZABLE and FULLSCREEN.
R83 ClientSettings stores and restores this enum through the exact settings.properties key screen_mode; its case-insensitive parser defaults to FIXED.
Client, RSApplet/RSFrame shell, launcher/layout code, interfaces and overlays reference this enum to branch on fixed/resizable/fullscreen presentation behavior.
The three modes are mutually exclusive top-level client display modes, directly matching the persisted setting and broad UI consumers.

proposals.note: ScreenMode is the conservative semantic name for the exact FIXED/RESIZABLE/FULLSCREEN client display-mode enum. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: The enum has exactly two surviving constants: SPAWNPK and RUNEX.
Each constant stores its exact display name (SpawnPK / Runex) and associated site string, while ClientSettings uses the selected value to derive variant-specific spk/rx data paths and flags.
Launcher and the live UI shell read the selected enum's display name when constructing the application window title.

ObjectDefinition runtime code branches on whether the selected value is SPAWNPK, demonstrating that this enum selects product/game-specific client behavior rather than serving as presentation-only text.

proposals.note: GameVariant is the conservative semantic name for the exact SPAWNPK/RUNEX client product selector. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
